title: Asmita Bhattarai CV
text:
Data Science Student | Aspiring Data Scientist & Analyst

abhatta3@byui.edu




Motivated Data Science student with a strong foundation in statistics, analytics, and programming. Passionate about transforming data into actionable insights and building data-driven solutions. Currently developing expertise in Python, R, SQL, and data visualization tools.




Expected April 2027
Brigham Young University–Idaho
Bachelor of Science in Data Science
Minor in Statistics

Relevant Coursework: Data Science, Statistical Analysis, Linear Algebra, Database Systems

Focus: Data Analytics, Machine Learning, and Predictive Modeling





Programming: Python, R, SQL
Data Tools: Excel
Technologies: Git, Linux (basic), PowerShell (basic)
Concepts: Data Cleaning, Data Visualization, Statistical Modeling, Machine Learning (foundations)







Cleaned and analyzed real-world datasets using Python and R

Applied statistical methods to identify trends and patterns

Created visualizations to communicate insights effectively





Designed and queried relational databases

Wrote complex SQL queries for data extraction and reporting





Presented insights in a clear and business-focused format






Receptionist & Accounting Assistant | Smart Service Inn
June 2020 – August 2021

Maintained financial records in Excel, including expense tracking, invoicing, and basic reconciliation.
Improved administrative workflows, reducing guest check-in processing time through better organization systems.
Handled guest inquiries and resolved issues efficiently, ensuring high-quality customer service and satisfaction.






Data Science and Analytics

Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning

Continuous Learning and Skill Development






Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

Effective communication and teamwork abilities

Actively seeking internships in Data Science or Analytics
